This directory contains the 33 unmodified `rinalmo/` source/resource files from
https://github.com/lbcb-sci/RiNALMo at commit
`2c2c5c14a5ae609d8c560a5d9ca32e51e0288955`.

The official pip package omits downstream subpackages required by the secondary
structure training script. ArchiveII entry points prepend this directory to the
Python namespace search path; the previous project environment is unchanged.
Every upstream file is checked against its original Git blob SHA1 in
`setup/archiveii_official_source_manifest.json` before training/evaluation.
